description: This file contains utility functions for reading and parsing configuration files related to anchor parameters and pyramid levels in an object detection framework, specifically for the RetinaNet model. It includes functions to read a config file, parse anchor parameters, and parse pyramid levels, utilizing external libraries such as configparser, numpy, and tensorflow.keras.

methods.name: read_config_file
methods.description: Reads and validates a configuration file, ensuring it contains the necessary sections and keys for anchor parameters and pyramid levels.

methods.name: parse_anchor_parameters
methods.description: Parses anchor ratios, scales, sizes, and strides from the configuration and returns an AnchorParameters object.

methods.name: parse_pyramid_levels
methods.description: Extracts pyramid level information from the configuration.
